title: GODMAN-LAUNCH — /godman-launch: fix wrong publish script path
description: cmdGodmanLaunch() in cmd-system.ts references 'scripts/godman-publish-all.sh' which does not exist. The actual launch script is 'scripts/godman-launch-day.sh' (Sprint 992). Fix the publishScriptExists check and the run instruction to point at godman-launch-day.sh.
